title: Constructible coefficients on the projective line
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, and let $S$ be of finite type
over $k$, and let $\Lambda$ be the finite ring killed by an
integer invertible in $k$ of [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions].
For every constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf $F$ on $\mathbf P^1_S$, every
higher direct image
$R^q\pi_*F$, for $\pi:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, is constructible.

proof.text: Extract finiteness of the original coefficient ring Lambda and its invertible exponent from the coefficient convention. Finite type over the field makes S Noetherian. It suffices to work over every affine open U of S: projective-space base change identifies the local projective line, inverse image preserves constructibility, and upperStarHomologyRightDerivedLowerStarIso identifies the restriction of the higher image with that for the local projection. Apply the proved source IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iSup_eq_top to glue; the empty base is included. The localization isomorphism is proved in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.TargetLocal from etale derived base change.

Over an affine finite-type base, use the proved source hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_exists_mono. Its truncated-resolution argument reduces the claim to embedding each constructible Q into a constructible G whose derived direct image has constructible homology in every integer degree. Apply the existing source exists_mono_biproduct_lowerStar_of_locallyOfFiniteType, the arbitrary finite-coefficient version of the finite-pushforward embedding lemma, to write G as a finite direct sum of h_* of finite constant Lambda-modules. Constant finite module sheaves are finite locally constant, finite direct image preserves constructibility, and finite direct sums preserve constructibility. The source formal embedding criterion supplies the resolution step, including negative-degree vanishing, without a Cartan--Eilenberg spectral sequence.

For each finite h:Y -> X, where X is the projective line over the affine Noetherian base, finite_over_projective_affineLocally makes h followed by the projection projective. All schemes involved remain finite type over the field. For each geometric base change, the fibre of this composite maps finitely to the corresponding fibre of the projective line. Incomparability for integral extensions, in the proved source geometric form Scheme.Hom.eq_of_specializes_of_apply_eq_of_isIntegralHom, says that comparable points with equal image are equal. The proved source topologicalKrullDim_le_of_continuous therefore bounds the source fibre dimension by the target fibre dimension. The projective-line fibre is a projective line over the geometric-point field, hence has dimension at most one. This treats empty, nonreduced and disconnected fibres without affine-cover dimension conversions.

For a finite Lambda-module M, choose the positive invertible annihilating exponent n supplied by HasInvertibleExponent. The additive group is killed by n. The proved Mathlib card_dvd_exponent_pow_rank' gives card(M) dividing n raised to its finite group rank. Consequently its cardinality is invertible on the base, by isUnit_of_dvd_unit. Apply projective-curve finiteness for constant finite abelian groups to the composite h followed by the projection. The coefficient-forgetting comparison and constantCommuteCompose identify the result with the abelian sheaf underlying the module higher direct image.

A constructible abelian sheaf gives a finite stratification with finite constant abelian local trivializations. On each stratum these imply local constancy and finite geometric stalks. The finite-local-abelian-forget equivalence turns them into finite locally constant underlying set sheaves. Forgetting to sets commutes with inverse image: use the left-Kan-extension comparison and preservation of sheafification. Transfer the stratification along the abelian comparison isomorphism. The finite-coefficient reconstruction theorem with the zero ideal of Lambda now proves module constructibility (Lambda itself is finite). This performs the scalar-action reconstruction directly over Lambda; no intermediate Z/n coefficients are needed.

Exactness of finite direct image, its derived-functor comparison, and derived composition give rightDerivedLowerStarSingleLowerStarIso: the derived projection-image of h_* of a constant module sheaf in degree zero is the derived image under the composite. Transfer constructibility along this isomorphism. Derived direct image and homology are additive and preserve finite biproducts, so the whole embedding target G has constructible higher images. The embedding criterion finishes the affine claim; the first step globalizes it. Finally use isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff and rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility to obtain exactly the stated bounded-below-derived theorem, with unchanged hypotheses and integer degree.
